concept: Breaking the generic 'white card on gray background' SaaS mold. A high-contrast, split-screen layout prioritizing emotional elegance. The functional form sits in a clean, minimalist void, contrasted by a cinematic, architectural/abstract texture on the opposing side.

brand_display_font.name: Playfair Display
brand_display_font.import_instruction: Add Google Font import for 'Playfair Display' (weights 400, 500, 600) to the main layout or app.css.
brand_display_font.usage: Use ONLY for the 'AdminKit' brand name and the hero tagline to create a 'Luxury/Editorial' contrast against the functional interface.

body_font.name: Geist
body_font.usage: Use for all inputs, labels, and standard text (already defined in the app).

hierarchy.h1_tagline: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight font-serif leading-tight mb-2
hierarchy.subtitle: text-sm text-muted-foreground

colors.palette_rules: Strict adherence to the existing monochrome compact UI (FlowDesk style). No new vibrant colors. Use pure contrast (black/white/zinc) using existing CSS variables.

layouts.main_container: min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row bg-background text-foreground
layouts.left_panel: w-full lg:w-[45%] xl:w-[40%] flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-8 lg:p-16 xl:p-24 relative z-10
layouts.right_panel: hidden lg:flex lg:w-[55%] xl:w-[60%] relative bg-zinc-950 overflow-hidden

credential_input.label: Kredensial (Email / Username / No. HP)
credential_input.classes: flex h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 transition-all shadow-sm

password_input.classes: flex h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 transition-all shadow-sm pr-10
password_input.toggle_button: absolute right-0 top-0 h-full px-3 py-2 hover:bg-transparent flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors

button.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-all focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 bg-foreground text-background hover:bg-foreground/90 h-11 px-4 py-2 w-full shadow-md active:scale-[0.98]
button.loading_state: Include Lucide Loader2 with 'animate-spin' class when submitting.

alerts.form_error: bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20 p-3 rounded-md text-sm flex items-start gap-2

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for form elements. Use 'animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500'. Apply utility classes or @vueuse/motion if installed.
motion.micro_interactions: Inputs have subtle shadow expansion on focus. Button scales down 2% on active (active:scale-[0.98]). Image panel has a very slow scale effect on load.

media.strategy: Render two distinct images based on the active theme (dark/light) to maintain emotional resonance.

dark_mode_image.description: Elegant abstract black and white wavy lines.
dark_mode_image.classes: hidden dark:block object-cover w-full h-full opacity-90 animate-in fade-in duration-1000

light_mode_image.classes: block dark:hidden object-cover w-full h-full opacity-95 animate-in fade-in duration-1000

media.overlay: Absolute inset-0 bg-black/10 dark:bg-black/40 pointer-events-none mix-blend-multiply dark:mix-blend-overlay

accessibility.aria: Use aria-invalid on inputs when errors exist. Use aria-describedby linking input to error message IDs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Inertia.js `useForm` for state management (kredensial, password, remember).

Implement the 'Kredensial' logic: one single input field bound to 'kredensial' in the form data, handling the fallback to email/username/phone on the backend (you only need to send the 'kredensial' payload).
Implement the password visibility toggle using a reactive ref.
Do NOT use external motion libraries unless already installed. Use Tailwind's built-in transition classes or `tailwindcss-animate`.

To handle Dark Mode gracefully, use the Tailwind `dark:` variant extensively on the form side, and use `dark:block hidden` vs `block dark:hidden` for the two provided Unsplash images on the right side.

Add a 'Tema Terang/Gelap' floating toggle ONLY if it doesn't exist globally; the prompt implies the toggle is already available in the app, but since this is an auth page, you may place a discrete toggle at the top right of the left panel if necessary.
DO NOT use `transparent` backgrounds over the image for the form. Keep the form strictly in the solid background panel (left side).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects only where appropriate (not for primary text readability areas).
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus rings.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
